name: n4_read_alarms
description: Read the station's alarm records, newest first: by default the open ones (unacknowledged or not back to normal). Each row is {timestamp, uuid, source, source_state, ack_state, alarm_class, priority, msg_text} as the station renders them (display text, e.g. '7 nov 2026 09:20:50 CST', 'Offnormal', 'Unacked'; msg_text may be a raw %lexicon(...)% pattern; once back to normal the record holds the toNormal text) plus timestamp_iso, normal_time and ack_time as ISO-8601 with the station's offset (null when not set); columns are the station's headers. Filters, all optional and combined with and: source (a component ORD such as station:|slot:/Drivers/Net; matches it and everything below it), source_glob (a BQL like pattern over the stored source such as *slot:/Drivers/Net/D*, '*' any run of characters, an escaped one included; no quote, space, '$' or '|'), alarm_class (a class name such as defaultAlarmClass), source_state (normal, offnormal, fault, alert), ack_state (acked, unacked, ackPending), since and until (BAbsTime, e.g. 2026-11-15T00:00:00.000-06:00, or a span back from now such as 30m, 24h or 7d). A source_state or ack_state filter replaces the open default; open_only false reads every record. where echoes the BQL where clause sent; truncated is true when more records match than limit; total is the matching record count (select count(*)), null with total_note when that count failed; state_counts=true adds state_counts {source_state {normal, offnormal, fault, alert}, ack_state {acked, unacked, ackPending}, records_counted, complete} counts every matching record per state (one more read, of the state tags), null with state_counts_note when that read failed. Every filter value is checked before any request, against its grammar and then as the station reads it ($xx / $uxxxx escapes decoded once, as BQL decodes them: one that decodes to a quote, space, '*', '|' or control character is refused): no quotes, wildcards or BQL of the caller reach the station. Read-only: fixed queries over the alarm: ORD.

source.description: Component ORD whose alarms to read, itself and below, e.g. station:|slot:/Drivers/Net

source_glob.description: BQL like pattern over the record source, '*' any run of characters, e.g. *slot:/Drivers/Net/D*

source_state.description: One of normal, offnormal, fault, alert; an empty string is no filter

ack_state.description: One of acked, unacked, ackPending; an empty string is no filter

since.description: Oldest alarm time as a BAbsTime, e.g. 2026-11-15T00:00:00.000-06:00 or 2026-11-15T06:00:00Z, or a span back from now: 30m, 24h, 7d

until.description: Newest alarm time as a BAbsTime, e.g. 2026-11-15T23:59:59.999-06:00, or a span back from now: 30m, 24h, 7d

open_only.description: true (default) reads only open alarms (unacked or not normal) unless a state filter is given; false reads every record

state_counts.description: true adds state_counts: every matching record counted per source and ack state (one more read)

timeout_s.description: HTTP timeout per request in seconds
